What members get

The free site shows what a town needs. Members get the tools to build a deal that meets it.

  • Market Analysis. Draw a market area around a site, compare areas, and see how much demand a project could capture.
  • Full housing needs chapters for each place. The free site gives a one-page summary.
  • Deal Calculator extras. Lender schedules and side-by-side A/B scenarios.
  • Research library. Briefs such as 4% and 9% twinning, set-asides and CHFA parking.
  • Common App map. Where each figure from your deal goes in CHFA's Common Application.
  • Next round watch. Deals likely to apply in CHFA's next tax credit rounds, built from CHFA and state award lists.

Want member access? Email info@cohoanalytics.com.
